about_the_game:
In Death Flags: The Beginning of the End – Chapter I, you immerse yourself in an intense virtual reality adventure as John Page, second-in-command aboard the dreaded pirate ship Splinter Skull. Under the command of the ruthless Captain Crow, you have witnessed countless plunderings, island destruction, and senseless murders.

But everything changes when Crow, obsessed with revenge against King Viktor, obtains a cursed sword summoned by the deep-sea demon Mordulack. Realizing the destructive power this weapon represents, John decides to break the cycle of violence: he betrays his captain and escapes the ship with the sword.

Your mission is clear: reach Fishbone Island, deliver the sword to King Viktor, and destroy it before it falls into the wrong hands.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains moderate gun violence. In some cases, headshots trigger an explosion animation, but there are no dismemberments or graphic depictions of mutilation. The remainder of the combat features body shots without exaggerated gore effects. There is no sexual content, nor references to drugs, alcohol, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 570 / NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible con DirectX
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (Link)
  • Additional Notes: Free space play with compatible headsets is recommended. Standard controllers required.

short_description: John Page, second-in-command of the Splintered Skull, betrays his captain after years of looting and murder. With a cursed sword in his hands, he sets out on a journey to Fishbone Island to deliver it to King Viktor and destroy it before its power corrupts anyone else.
